headline: UK Legal Aid Agency hackers stole decades of records
summary: Hackers who breached the UK Legal Aid Agency's IT systems in April 2025 stole records dating back to 1978, including probation service data.

claims.statement: Hackers who breached the Legal Aid Agency's IT systems stole records dating back to 1978.

sources.quote: UK Legal Aid Agency: Hackers stole records dating back to 1978
Legal Aid Agency hackers made off with records dating back to 1978

claims.statement: The breach of the agency's IT systems occurred in April 2025.

sources.quote: The Legal Aid Agency (LAA), an executive agency of the UK's Ministry of Justice that manages the country's Public Defender Service, says attackers who breached its IT systems in April 2025 stole records dating back to 1978

claims.statement: Probation service records were also among the stolen data.

sources.quote: Nearly 50 years of data caught up in breach, with probation service records also among the haul
